verdict.rationale: Gmail has a documented public REST API. First-party docs cover the message send endpoint (POST /gmail/v1/users/{userId}/messages/send), MIME sending requirements, push notifications for mailbox changes, granular OAuth scopes, and use cases such as organization, filtering and read-only extraction. A community user also confirms the Gmail API is a workable programmatic interface compared with IMAP. Missing for 10: a machine-readable spec for agents, since probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI document at the checked paths.
